lens: product/infrastructure hybrid rubric + public app release gate + CANON-011/019/031/041/045/047/048/051
primaryListVerdict: Four primary Genius items were live-verified: remote browser proof is already green; the Obelisk round-trip is authorization-gated despite being misclassified actionable; the promotion route matrix and stranded-deploy alarm are real local work. Three compounding truth fixes were promoted from the second-order survey.

items.title: Turn the post-promotion browser receipt into a critical-route evidence matrix
items.why: Production reconciliation observes only `/`, so a clean homepage can hide a broken member portal or flagship game route.
items.premise: `observeBrowser()` hard-codes one page and the receipt stores only aggregate console/cardinality fields.
liveEvidence: current receipt is behind and homepage-only
items.outcome: conversion + info-finding: every promotion proves the homepage, Vault Member entry, and a flagship game route without collapsing route-specific failures into one number.
items.recipe: Add a deterministic critical-route matrix, per-route console/request evidence, honest-dark partial capture, aggregate compatibility fields, and negative-path self-tests.

L1.recipe: Add a route list and visit each route.

L2.recipe: Persist per-route evidence while preserving aggregate consumers.

L3.recipe: Model partial capture honestly, validate every route, and prove aggregate/route invariants.

items.title: Escalate consecutive stranded deployments into the CI status beacon
items.why: The newest promotion record is genuinely `behind`, but the public CI beacon cannot distinguish one settling deploy from a repeated stranded-deploy incident.
items.premise: `summarizeHistory()` records only `lastStrandedAt`; `build-ci-status-beacon.mjs` never reads promotion history.
liveEvidence: CI beacon WATCHED/classify has no promotion signal
items.outcome: info-finding: operators and agents can see a consecutive-behind streak, threshold, and non-fabricated deployment alarm directly in the canonical beacon.
items.recipe: Extract a tail-safe promotion history summary, compute current consecutive behind streak, inject a thresholded deployment signal into the beacon, and self-test 0/1/N paths.

L2.recipe: Add thresholded beacon field and summary copy.

L3.recipe: Tail-safe parser, explicit signal state, and regression fixtures.

items.title: Fail closed when a task says it lands only with an authorized auth repair
items.why: The current Genius List ranks an Obelisk behavior change as actionable even though its own sentence says it lands with the authorized repair and the adoption source says founder authorization plus missing RP credentials.
items.premise: `gateForTask()` matches explicit founder/credential words but misses `authorized auth repair` and similar dependency language.
liveEvidence: .cache/genius-list.json ranks the behavioral Obelisk item #1 actionable
the duplicate replacement item is correctly credential-gated
items.outcome: info-finding: authorization-dependent auth/security work can never enter the unattended implementation queue through phrasing drift.
items.recipe: Extract authorization-dependency detection, add negative/positive self-tests, gate the live item, and regenerate the list.

L3.recipe: Make the detector exported/tested and verify the live list reclassification.

items.title: Make READY mean the Cloudflare token can access every production-bound resource
items.why: Secrets discovery says `cloudflare.deploy` READY and the local checker says scope is documented, while every recent Worker deployment is red and RUM/TT ingest has been dark since July 3.
items.premise: `probe-capability.mjs` verifies only `/user/tokens/verify`; `check-worker-deploy-token-scope.mjs` verifies workflow prose, not provider authorization.
liveEvidence: Deploy Cloudflare Worker has four consecutive failures
probe-capability cloudflare.deploy never probes account/R2 access
items.outcome: info-finding: a credential is called deploy-capable only when the provider accepts the token for the resources the Worker binds.
items.recipe: Add read-only bound-resource acceptance probes through the secrets gateway, distinguish valid-token/scope-denied/provider-unreachable, redact output, and pin pure interpretation tests.

L1.recipe: Probe account and R2 list endpoints.

L2.recipe: Return a scope-specific result without leaking credentials.

L3.recipe: Derive required resources from wrangler config and test partial permission matrices.

items.title: Make every SIL surface derive the same current score before rendering
items.why: The preserved worktree says 993 while the freshly rendered startup brief says 997, so the session begins with two authoritative-looking scores.
items.premise: `check-sil-integrity` validates category arithmetic but does not compare `PROJECT_STATUS.silScore` to the latest SIL entry used by the brief.
items.outcome: info-finding: status JSON, startup brief, and Genius scoring cannot disagree silently; stale inputs fail before public surfaces regenerate.
items.recipe: Create a pure latest-SIL reader/invariant, wire it into the integrity gate, and make renderers consume or reject the same source.

L3.recipe: Test status/brief/list coherence and repair the source, not the report.

items.title: Close the `/ip` discovery gap without duplicating or weakening the proprietary rights source
items.why: The live repo has a strong `/rights/` page but no canonical `/ip/` entry required by the current sitemap standard; the control-plane checker also undercounts directory routes.
items.premise: Repo files include `rights/index.html`, privacy/terms/contact directory pages, and no `ip/index.html`; the canonical checker only recognizes flat `.html` paths.
liveEvidence: privacy, terms, and contact exist as directory routes but are not recognized
items.outcome: conversion + info-finding: humans and agents have a stable `/ip/` doorway into the studio's proprietary posture, and the checker receives reproducible evidence instead of a locally forged score.
items.recipe: Add a branded `/ip/` route that summarizes and links to the existing rights source without changing license terms, include it in discovery/sitemap generation, and ship the directory-route checker defect through Ark.

L3.recipe: Add source-level route contract and Ark repro for the control-plane checker.

items.title: Close the post-push browser proof carry with current GitHub evidence
items.why: The task is verification, not a feature; leaving it open after green evidence pollutes every future Genius List.
items.premise: The last substantive main push has E2E, Accessibility, and Lighthouse success on the same head SHA.
items.outcome: info-finding: the release carry is closed with remote proof and no phantom implementation work.
items.recipe: Record the shared-head proof in TASK_BOARD/TRUTH_AUDIT and regenerate the Genius List.

L2.recipe: Require shared head SHA and terminal success.

L3.recipe: Teach future verification pruning to cite the proof automatically.
